reasons: Candidate outputs were checked only for repeat determinism and were not compared with canonical same-backend/same-role baseline outputs.
Embedding inputs were duplicated, so response reordering could not be detected reliably.
GPU memory used a host-global peak contaminated by unrelated processes instead of llama-server process residency.
CPU cells were incorrectly gated on unrelated host GPU activity.
Reranker maximum requests included template overhead only at runtime and the rejecting baseline was still used for partial comparisons.
Per-sequence context was derived when explicit runtime readback was missing.
